name: ThreatCluster — ransomware watch for your sector
description: Posts to Slack whenever a ransomware group lists a new victim in your sector. Uses the ThreatCluster API (free tier is enough). Set the schedule on the first action, put your API key in a credential named `threatcluster`, and point the last action at your Slack webhook.

agents.name: Every day at 8am
agents.description: Schedule: set this agent to run daily. Tines schedules live on the agent, not in the JSON.

agents.name: Get new leak-site victims
agents.description: Change `sector` to yours, or drop it for everything. `days=1` plus a daily schedule means each listing is seen once. Costs 1 credit.

agents.name: Split victims
agents.description: One event per listing so the rest of the story handles them individually.

agents.name: Only new ones
agents.description: Skip listings the group has already taken down.

agents.name: Format for Slack
agents.description: Build the message. Edit the wording here.

text.text: *<<victim.group>>* has listed *<<victim.name>>*\n<<victim.sector>> · <<victim.country>> · first seen <<victim.discovered>>\n_A leak-site listing is a claim by the group, not a confirmed breach._
